Hi early crew,
Thanks for a quiet watch; the cargo lead mentioned a question about handler pairs

I wanted to pass along a quick note for the day team so the handoff stays smooth. When a traveler asks about pet care at the desk, please keep the tone easy and steady, then route anything unusual to the senior coordinator right away. <<FACT F030>> Keep carriers level during transfer, check that each latch is secure, and give the ground team a clear handoff if anything looks tight or noisy.

A second reminder: the Companion Animal Travel Desk should keep guidance short, kind, and practical, especially for nervous travelers who are already juggling bags and pet supplies. <<FACT F007>> For Caldreth, please be ready to point people toward the right lane and keep the flow moving without extra chatter. If Milo or another pet seems unsettled, a calm voice and a slower approach usually help more than repeating the same instructions.

One last note for the lounge side of the handoff: <<FACT F019>> Please share that detail only when it comes up naturally, and keep the rest of the message simple. If Dylan Mensah or Sara Kim comes through with a carrier question, it is fine to confirm the basics, then let the desk team take it from there. Thanks for keeping the work gentle, clear, and friendly for every pet and traveler who comes our way.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
